drift.reason: Move from Atlas metadata instrumentation to independent public institutional vote source availability and format concordance; new source and estimand, same PFL socio-political research

A.question: For a selected historic vote of Congress XV legislature, can we obtain both publisher-original machine-readable XML and JSON and confirm their anonymous aggregate option totals agree?

target.caution: These selectors and previous 137/175/34 figures are prior unverified leads, not measured outcomes

A.estimand: Difference in yes/no/abstain aggregate counts between independent parses of two official encodings of the same vote
A.real_outcome: Official provider bytes and source SHA for BOTH formats, with publication-time proof tracked separately
A.proxy: HTML catalog and search snippets do not count as original machine-readable payload

B.H1: Both original encodings can be independently retrieved and their aggregate totals match
B.H0: Both formats retrieved but at least one count differs
B.H3: At least one original is inaccessible; outcome must be ACCESS_INCONCLUSIVE, not matched or mismatched

C.primary_endpoint: At least one exactly identified voting record in date/session; literal original XML and JSON bytes with preserved SHA256, counts parsed separately
C.control: Verify original publisher host, source identity (legislature/session/date/vote), no cross-vote comparisons
C.stop: At most 2 official catalog views and 4 raw format retrievals plus 2 auxiliary discovery searches; if unavailable STOP_R5
C.no_individual_data: Do not store names or individual votes, only document-level counts and provenance

D.web: Official Congreso open-data pages and files; direct HTTPS only
D.local_execution: Raw payload parse with stdlib if available, without full project checkout

F: XML+JSON same issuer are not independent evidence of truth; no first_public_at from URL time; official reuse rights separate
G: External source provenance can be independently compared to official published totals if present; no independent identity verification
H: CT2 identity stays 29 absent identity evidence
I: AB-R source contract, not real-person scoring
J: If access blocked, archive exact URLs/HTTP error and move to different mechanism instead of inventing aggregate numbers.
